description: Zigbee smart energy meter with leakage and prepayment
exposes_summary: switch (state), countdown, power_on_behavior, inching, status, power, current, voltage, energy, energy_produced, leakage_current, device_temperature, faults, reclosing, reclosing_delay, reclosing_count, prepayment, energy_balance, energy_balance_add, energy_balance_reset, alarm_set_1, over_current_threshold_time, alarm_set_2, alarm_set_3, lost_flow_threshold_time

exposes.name: Countdown
exposes.description: Toggle the device after a set duration (one time action).

exposes.name: Power on behavior
exposes.description: State to apply after a power outage (It takes ~35s to check faults before applying).

exposes.name: Inching
exposes.description: Inching configuration.

features.description: Whenever the device is switched ON, switch it OFF automatically after the configured delay
Minutes component of the delay duration max value is 1440, unit is m
Seconds component of the delay duration max value is 59, unit is s

exposes.name: Status
exposes.description: Current operating status.

exposes.name: Power
exposes.description: Instantaneous measured power.

exposes.name: Current
exposes.description: Instantaneous measured electrical current.

exposes.name: Voltage
exposes.description: Measured electrical potential value.

exposes.name: Energy
exposes.description: Sum of consumed energy.

exposes.name: Energy produced
exposes.description: Sum of produced energy.

exposes.name: Leakage current
exposes.description: Current measured by the external ring. Place it over BOTH live and neutral wires to detect leakage current.

exposes.name: Device temperature
exposes.description: Temperature of the device.

exposes.name: Faults
exposes.description: List of current faults.

exposes.name: Reclosing
exposes.description: Automatically attempt switching ON the circuit after it was turned OFF by a detected fault (WARNING: It seems this happens even when disabled).

exposes.name: Reclosing delay
exposes.description: Time to wait after the fault is cleared, before attempting reclose.

exposes.name: Reclosing count
exposes.description: Number of allowed reclosing attempts per fault.

exposes.name: Prepayment
exposes.description: Automatically switch OFF the circuit when the energy balance reaches zero.

exposes.name: Energy balance
exposes.description: Amount of energy allowed for consumption (Decreases when Prepayment is enabled).

exposes.name: Energy balance add
exposes.description: Add an amount of energy to the balance.

exposes.name: Energy balance reset
exposes.description: Set the energy balance to zero.

exposes.name: Alarm set 1
exposes.description: Leakage current and temperature alarms configuration.

features.description: Automatically switch OFF the circuit when the leakage current is above the limit (Default ON)
Leakage current limit (Default 50mA) min value is 1, max value is 99, unit is mA
Automatically switch OFF the circuit when the measured temperature exceeds the limit (Default ON)
Temperature limit (Default 80°C) min value is 10, max value is 85, unit is °C

exposes.name: Over current threshold time
exposes.description: Time overcurrent is allowed before the circuit is switched OFF (Default 0s).

exposes.name: Alarm set 2
exposes.description: Current and voltage alarms configuration.

features.description: Automatically switch OFF the circuit when the circuit draws more current than the limit (Default ON)
Current upper limit (Default 63A) min value is 1, max value is 80, unit is A
Automatically switch OFF the circuit when the voltage is above the limit (Default ON)
Voltage upper limit (Default 275V) min value is 120, max value is 300, unit is V
Automatically switch OFF the circuit when the voltage is below the limit (Default ON)
Voltage lower limit (Default 175V) min value is 80, max value is 210, unit is V

exposes.name: Alarm set 3
exposes.description: Lost flow alarm configuration.

features.description: Unknown min value is 1, max value is 100, unit is A

exposes.name: Lost flow threshold time
exposes.description: Unknown (Default 0s).
